why.title: A simple way to book Hurghada
why.lead: Clear tour details, multilingual pages, and a booking flow designed for international visitors.

reviews.title: What our guests say
reviews.lead: Honest words from guests who spent a day with us in Hurghada — shown in the language they wrote.

quotes.anna: The island day was the highlight of our week in Hurghada — calm organisation and beautiful water.
quotes.lucas: Easy to book online, and the meeting point was exactly as described. A relaxed snorkeling morning.
quotes.olga: We wanted a desert day from Hurghada without the stress. Clear timing and a well-paced trip.
quotes.james: Good value and a straightforward booking. We would use the same team for a Cairo day next time.
quotes.sara: Family-friendly pace, and the tour details on the website matched the day we had.

reviews.empty: Be the first to share your experience after a tour with Hurghada Horizon.

aboutPage.heroTitle: Days on the Red Sea, planned from the coast
aboutPage.heroLead: Hurghada Horizon organises boat trips, island days, snorkeling, desert safari, and Egypt excursions. The tour page is the plan: time, meeting point, price, and what is included.
aboutPage.storyP1: We work from Hurghada, on Egypt’s Red Sea coast. Island boats, reef days, desert afternoons, and trips toward Luxor or Cairo are arranged here, then published with the details you need before you book.
aboutPage.storyP2: Nothing extra is implied. Airport transfers, meals, and equipment appear only when that tour listing says they are included.
aboutPage.pillar1Body: Price, timing, and the meeting point are written on the tour before you send a request.
aboutPage.pillar2Body: Reefs, desert, and historic sites stay part of the day. We ask every group to treat them carefully.
aboutPage.pillar3Body: You know where to be and what happens next, so the morning does not turn into a search.
aboutPage.stepsTitle: From the listing to the day
aboutPage.step1Body: Browse what is actually on offer, from the sea to the desert and further into Egypt.
aboutPage.step2Body: Duration, time, location, and what is included or left out sit on the same page.
aboutPage.step3Body: Tell us the group size. We confirm after the request is reviewed.
aboutPage.ctaLead: Open the tours, or start a booking if you already know the day you want.
aboutPage.quote: The best travel days start with a clear plan and a calm start.
